fallback: Something went wrong. Please try again.
network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

code.CLIENT_NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
code.CLIENT_TIMEOUT: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.
code.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
code.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account already uses this email.
code.PHONE_TAKEN: An account already uses this phone number.
code.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That phone number or password is incorrect.
code.INVALID_RESET_TOKEN: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
code.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: This account is locked. Contact support to unlock it.
code.LOGIN_TEMPORARILY_LOCKED: Too many failed attempts. Sign-in is paused — try again in a few minutes, or use "Forgot password".
code.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account doesn't have a password yet. Set one for the first time instead of changing it.
code.PASSWORD_UNCHANGED: Your new password must be different from the current one.
code.PHONE_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Please sign in with your phone number and password.
code.OTP_LOGIN_RETIRED: Signing in with a one-time code is no longer supported. Sign in with your phone number and password, or use "Forgot password".
code.SOCIAL_NOT_CONFIGURED: This sign-in option is not available yet. Please sign in with your phone number and password.
code.SOCIAL_STATE_INVALID: That sign-in attempt has expired. Please start again.
code.SOCIAL_CANCELLED: You cancelled at the permission step, so you weren't signed in.
code.SOCIAL_EXCHANGE_FAILED: We couldn't reach the sign-in provider. Please try again in a moment.
code.SOCIAL_TOKEN_INVALID: We couldn't verify this account. Please try signing in again.
code.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
code.MISSING_PERMISSION: You don't have permission to do this.
code.NO_TENANT_SCOPE: This account doesn't belong to a shop yet.
code.TENANT_NOT_ACTIVE: This shop is not active yet.
code.BANNER_VISIBLE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many banners would show at the same time. Turn off or reschedule another banner first.
code.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details aren't valid. Please review the form.
code.MONEY_STEP_1000: Prices must be a multiple of 1,000 VND
code.CONFLICT: This changed somewhere else. Reload and try again.
code.REVIEW_EDIT_LIMIT: You have already used your one review edit.
code.SUBSCRIPTION_INVOICE_PARTIALLY_PAID: You already have a plan invoice that has received part of its payment. Transfer the remaining amount using the original reference code, or contact support — don't create a new invoice.
code.BOOKING_SCHEDULE_CONFLICT: This vehicle is already booked for that period.
code.BOOKING_REQUEST_DUPLICATE: You've already sent an identical request and the shop is reviewing it.
code.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your current plan has reached its limit.
code.FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN: This feature belongs to a plan your shop doesn't have yet. Browse the plans to unlock it.
code.FEATURE_READ_ONLY: Your plan expired, so this feature is view-only. Your existing data is untouched — renew to keep adding.
code.PLAN_INCENTIVE_INVALID: This pricing makes the plan cheaper than commission even below its included slots. Raise the base fee, lower the included slots, or review the revenue assumptions.
code.HOLD_REQUIRED: Send the reservation payment to confirm this trip.
code.HOLD_EXPIRED: The reservation payment window closed, so the car was released to other guests. You can book again.
code.HOLD_ALREADY_PAID: This reservation payment has already been received.
code.HOLD_NOT_REFUNDABLE: The free-cancellation window has passed, so the reservation payment isn't refundable.
code.INSTANT_BOOK_UNAVAILABLE: This trip can't be booked instantly. Send a request and the host will quote you.
code.WALLET_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Your available balance doesn't cover this withdrawal.
code.RECEIPT_SOURCE_LOCKED: This receipt was generated by a business action — reverse it there, not on the receipt.
code.PHONE_NOT_VERIFIED: Please verify your phone number first.
code.OTP_EXPIRED: The verification code has expired. Request a new one.
code.OTP_COOLDOWN: Please wait a moment before requesting another code.
code.OTP_TOO_MANY: Too many codes requested. Try again in a few minutes.
code.OTP_LOCKED: Too many incorrect attempts. Try again later.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_IMAGE_INVALID: The uploaded file is not a valid image — choose a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_SUBMISSION_LIMIT: You have sent many licence photos in the last 24 hours. Please try again tomorrow, or contact XePrime if you need help.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_STATE_CONFLICT: Your licence submission has just changed — please reload the page.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_CLASS_MISMATCH: Your driving licence class does not cover this type of vehicle.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_EXPIRED: Your driving licence expires before the trip ends — please update to a valid licence.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_PENDING_REVIEW: Your licence is still being read — try again in a few seconds.
code.DRIVER_LICENCE_REQUIRED: Please verify your driving licence before booking a self-drive vehicle.
code.OCR_PROCESSING: Still reading the document. Try again in a moment.
code.OCR_UNREADABLE: We couldn't read that document photo. Please retake it more clearly.
code.OCR_FAILED: Reading the document failed. Please enter the details manually.
code.ODOMETER_DECREASE_FORBIDDEN: The new odometer reading can't be lower than the recorded one.
code.HANDOVER_ODOMETER_BELOW_PICKUP: The return reading can't be lower than the pickup reading.
code.HANDOVER_ODOMETER_SUSPICIOUS: That mileage difference looks unusual. Please double-check it.
code.HANDOVER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This booking isn't ready for handover.
code.VEHICLE_CODE_DUPLICATE: This vehicle code is already used in your shop (including deleted vehicles). Use another code or leave it blank to auto-generate.
code.CUSTOMER_PHONE_DUPLICATE: This phone number is already in your customer book.
code.CUSTOMER_BLOCKED: This customer is on your refused-service list.
code.SHOP_NOT_ACCEPTING_CUSTOMER: The shop that owns this vehicle is not accepting booking requests from your account at the moment. Please choose a vehicle from another shop.
code.CHAT_CUSTOMER_UNAVAILABLE: This guest has no XePrime account yet, so in-app messaging is unavailable — call them or reach out on Zalo.
code.CHAT_REQUIRES_BOOKING: You can message individual hosts once your holding payment goes through. Until then, use your rental request.
code.BRANCH_HAS_DEPENDENCIES: This branch still has related records, so it can't be deleted.
code.BRANCH_DEFAULT_IMMUTABLE: The default branch can't be edited or deleted.
code.BRANCH_LOCATION_REQUIRED: This branch needs an address before it can be used.
code.RATE_LIMITED: That was too fast. Try again in a few seconds.
code.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server hit a problem. Please try again later.
code.INSURANCE_PARTNER_NOT_CONFIGURED: No insurance partner is connected in this environment — retrying won't issue a certificate.
code.UPLOAD_FAILED: The upload failed. Please try again.
code.TRIP_CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED: This trip can no longer be cancelled. Please contact the host.
code.TRIP_NOT_RECEIVED_NOT_ALLOWED: You can no longer report that you did not receive the vehicle for this trip. Please contact support.
code.TRIP_NOT_RECEIVED_TOO_EARLY: The pickup time has not arrived yet, so you cannot report that you did not receive the vehicle.
code.TRIP_NOT_RECEIVED_WINDOW_CLOSED: The time to report that you did not receive the vehicle has passed. Please open a support request.
code.PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Your shop profile is still missing required details, so it cannot be submitted for review.
code.SHOP_LISTING_REQUIREMENTS_MISSING: Your shop profile is still missing required details, so this vehicle cannot be submitted.
code.RECEIPT_BOOKING_VEHICLE_MISMATCH: The booking you picked does not run the vehicle you picked. Clear one of the two.
code.BOOKING_REQUEST_EXPIRED: This request passed its response deadline and closed itself.
code.BOOKING_NO_SHOW_NOT_ALLOWED: Can't mark a no-show yet — it is less than 30 minutes past pickup time, or the vehicle was already handed over.
code.INVITE_INVALID: This invitation does not exist, was already answered, or has been revoked.
code.INVITE_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask the shop to send a new one.
code.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email address than the one on the account you are signed in with.
code.INVITE_PHONE_MISMATCH: This invitation is for a different phone number. Sign in with the account that has the invited number.
code.INVITE_ALREADY_MEMBER: You are already a member of this shop.
code.BANK_TX_ALREADY_HANDLED: This transaction has already been handled. Reload the list to see its current state.
code.BANK_TX_TARGET_NOT_PAYABLE: The selected invoice can no longer accept payment. Ask the shop to issue a new invoice and match against the new code.
code.PAYMENT_GATEWAY_UNAVAILABLE: This payment method is not available yet. Please pay by bank transfer using the QR code.
code.PAYMENT_GATEWAY_PROVIDER_ERROR: We could not reach the payment gateway. Nothing has been charged — try again in a few minutes or pay by bank transfer.
code.PAYMENT_TARGET_NOT_PAYABLE: This item is no longer awaiting payment. Reload the page to see its latest status.
code.PAYMENT_HOLD_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: Too little time is left on this reservation to pay through a gateway. Please pay by bank transfer with the QR code now.
code.PAYMENT_AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: The amount is outside this gateway's limits. Please choose another payment method.
code.PAYMENT_GATEWAY_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The payment gateway signature is invalid.
code.PAYMENT_ORDER_ALREADY_HANDLED: This payment was just handled. Reload to see its latest status.
code.PAYMENT_ORDER_IN_PROGRESS: A gateway payment for this item is being recorded. Please wait a few minutes and reload — do not pay again.
code.HANDOVER_WINDOW_VIOLATION: Pickup or return time is outside the host’s handover hours. Pick another time.
code.RENTAL_TERMS_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: You need to accept the host’s rental terms before sending.
code.MIN_RENTAL_DURATION: The rental is shorter than the host’s minimum duration.
code.VEHICLE_FIELD_LOCKED: This vehicle is live on the marketplace, so its plate number, vehicle type, transmission, fuel type and manufacture year cannot be changed. Remove it from the marketplace first.
code.VEHICLE_TRANSMISSION_INCOMPATIBLE: This transmission doesn't match the vehicle's fuel type.
code.CATALOG_MODEL_DUPLICATE: This brand already has a model with that name.
code.CATALOG_MODEL_IN_USE: Vehicles are linked to this model — turn it off instead of deleting it so they keep their link.
code.CATALOG_MODEL_SPEC_INVALID: The model's specs don't fit together: check the energy source, transmission, seats and years sold.
code.BANK_ACCOUNT_DUPLICATE: This bank account is already in your list.
code.BANK_ACCOUNT_REPLACE_NOT_CONFIRMED: You can only have one payout account. To switch to this one, turn on “Make this my default payout account” and save again.
code.WITHDRAWAL_BELOW_MINIMUM: Amount is below the minimum withdrawal.
code.WITHDRAWAL_ALREADY_HANDLED: This withdrawal request has already been handled.
code.DEPOSIT_ALWAYS_REQUIRED: Shops on the commission track always collect deposits through XePrime — this switch cannot be turned off.
code.SHOP_VERIFICATION_PENDING: Your shop profile is already waiting to be verified.
code.PACKAGE_ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE: Your shop has not finished paying for its first plan. Complete the transfer to unlock the shop management tools.
code.PARTNER_ACCESS_REQUIRED: This account is not eligible for the XePrime Partner app. It is for shops on a service plan; if you are a renter or a commission-track owner, please use the XePrime app.
code.SHOP_NOT_ACTIVE: Your shop is locked, so this action is not available.
code.TENANT_BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED: This shop has no active service plan, so fees cannot be calculated. Contact XePrime support before accepting new bookings.
code.VEHICLE_PUBLISH_INCOMPLETE: This vehicle is still missing required details, so it cannot be submitted.
code.VEHICLE_IMAGES_INCOMPLETE: This vehicle is missing required photos — cars need 5 (front, rear, left, right, interior), motorbikes need 2 (front, rear).
code.VEHICLE_NOT_APPROVED_PUBLIC: XePrime has not approved this vehicle yet, so it cannot go live on the marketplace. Submit it for review first.
code.VEHICLE_PLATFORM_HIDDEN: XePrime has hidden this vehicle. Contact XePrime support to have it reviewed again.
code.FAVORITE_VEHICLE_UNAVAILABLE: This vehicle is no longer on the marketplace, so it couldn't be saved.
code.APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED: Someone else has just handled this request. Reloading the latest status.
code.APPROVAL_CHECKLIST_INCOMPLETE: Complete the manual checks before approving.
code.APPROVAL_NOTE_CONFLICT: Someone else just edited this note. Review the latest version before saving again.
code.APPROVAL_SUBJECT_CHANGED: The vehicle no longer matches its submission, so it cannot be approved. Ask the owner to check it and resubmit.
code.SHOP_ACCOUNT_CANNOT_BOOK: Partner accounts cannot book rentals. Sign in to XePrime with a renter account — the same phone number works.
code.CANNOT_BOOK_OWN_VEHICLE: Your phone number belongs to the shop that owns this vehicle, so you cannot book it.
code.CANNOT_DECIDE_OWN_REQUEST: You cannot approve or decline a request you sent yourself.
code.SURCHARGE_CATEGORY_DUPLICATE: This booking already has an excess mileage surcharge. Remove the existing one to record it again.
code.HOLD_LIMIT_REACHED: You have too many trips awaiting payment. Pay for one, or cancel it, and try again.
code.BOOKING_CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED: This trip is no longer at a stage you can cancel from here.
code.COMMISSION_PLAN_IS_SINGLETON: The commission track can only have one default tier.
code.PLAN_NOT_SELF_SERVE: This plan is configured for your shop size — contact XePrime for advice and a quote.
code.PLAN_NOT_PUBLISHED: This plan is not on sale yet. Pick another plan or reload the price list.
code.SUBSCRIPTION_TERM_CONFLICT: This shop already has another plan term overlapping this period for this vehicle type. Reload to see the latest terms.
code.PLAN_SCOPE_REQUIRED: Your shop has no plan for this vehicle type yet. Buy a plan for that type to add vehicles and list them on the marketplace.
code.SUBSCRIPTION_LATER_TERM_EXISTS: This shop already has a term scheduled right after this one. Cancel the scheduled term first, or use “Change plan now”.
code.PLAN_IN_USE: This plan already has subscriptions or invoices, so it cannot be deleted — turn it off instead.
code.DEFAULT_PLAN_PROTECTED: This is the commission track’s default tier — it cannot be switched to a paid plan or turned off.
code.DEFAULT_COMMISSION_PLAN_MISSING: The plan catalog has no default commission tier, so the shop cannot be opened.
code.HOLD_NOT_PENDING: This reservation hold is no longer pending.
code.HOLD_WINDOW_TOO_SHORT: Pickup is too soon to collect a reservation payment — arrange it directly with the customer.
code.HOLD_LOCKED_BY_DISPUTE: This reservation hold is held while a dispute is still open.
code.PROMO_CODE_NOT_APPLICABLE: This promo code does not apply to this trip.
code.PROMO_CODE_EXHAUSTED: This promo code just ran out of uses. Please check the price before continuing.
code.PROMO_CODE_LOCKED: This code has already been redeemed — its discount, conditions and scope are locked. Duplicate it instead.
code.FEE_POLICY_MISSING: No fee policy is in effect. Please contact XePrime.
code.FEE_POLICY_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be edited, activated or discarded — an active policy is immutable.
code.FEE_POLICY_ACTIVATION_BLOCKED: This policy does not meet the requirements for activation yet.
code.REFUND_ALREADY_HANDLED: This refund has already been handled.
code.REFUND_ACCOUNT_REQUIRED: The customer has not provided an account to receive the refund.
code.SELLER_PROFILE_NOT_EDITABLE: The profile is under review — it cannot be edited until there is a decision.
code.SELLER_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: The profile is missing required information.
code.SUPPORT_CASE_CLOSED: This support case is closed. Please open a new one instead.
code.SUPPORT_CASE_PLATFORM_RESOLVE_ONLY: This case involves the trip's money, so only XePrime can resolve or close it.
code.SUPPORT_CASE_CATEGORY_NOT_ALLOWED: This case category cannot be submitted here.
code.PLAN_CONSULTATION_DISABLED: Plan consultation in the app is not available yet.
code.PLAN_GUIDE_TEMPLATE_ACTIVE: This template set is in use and cannot be deleted. Switch to another set first.
code.PLAN_GUIDE_TEMPLATE_CODE_TAKEN: This template code is already used. Choose another one.
code.PLAN_GUIDE_TEST_NO_EMAIL: Your account has no email address to receive the test email.
code.SHOP_OWNER_ONLY: Only the shop owner can view and withdraw the shop’s money.
code.BRANCH_SCOPE_EXCEEDED: You can only assign branches within your own scope, and cannot change members who cover other branches.
code.SUBSCRIPTION_TRACK_ONLY: This area is for shops on a paid plan.
code.APPROVAL_SNAPSHOT_STALE: The owner just updated this profile. Reload the request and review the new version before approving — the manual checks have been reset too.
code.SUPPORT_CONTEXT_INVALID: This support session is not valid for your account or current sign-in session.
code.SUPPORT_CONTEXT_EXPIRED: The support session has expired or ended. Open a new one from the Shops screen.
code.SUPPORT_ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: This action is outside the scope of the support session.
code.SUPPORT_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: The support session cannot change these fields (price, services, branch, operating status…).
code.SUPPORT_MEDIA_OUT_OF_SCOPE: This photo is not in this shop's photo storage. Upload it again within the support session.
code.CUSTOMER_APP_NOT_AVAILABLE: Shop accounts use the XePrime Partner app. Please open XePrime Partner and sign in with this account.
code.PARTNER_REGISTRATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: The XePrime Partner app does not create new accounts. Please sign up for a partner account at partner.xeprime.vn, then come back here to sign in.
code.SUPPORT_REASON_REQUIRED: This action needs its own reason — say why, or give the owner's request code.
code.SUPPORT_OPEN_TRIPS: The vehicle has trips that haven't ended — this can't be changed right now.
code.SUPPORT_BLOCK_NOT_OWNED: A support session can only edit or remove future blocks it created itself.
code.TRIP_REMIND_TOO_SOON: The host was reminded about this request a moment ago — wait a few minutes before reminding again.
code.INVITE_SCOPE_STALE: The branches in this invite no longer exist. Ask the shop to send a new invite.
code.REALM_UNRESOLVED: We couldn't tell which XePrime site you're on. Reload the page and try again.
code.REALM_NOT_ALLOWED: This account can't be used here. Sign in on the site meant for your account.
code.REALM_LOGIN_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This sign-in method isn't available here. Sign in with your email and password.
code.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: The request was blocked because it didn't come from a XePrime page. Reload the page and try again.
code.MEMBER_ALREADY_IN_OTHER_TENANT: This account already works for another shop. Each partner account belongs to one shop only.
code.OTP_SMS_REQUIRED_IN_PRODUCTION: Production always sends OTP SMS — this switch cannot be turned off.
code.DRIVER_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: This phone number has no verified XePrime account. Ask the driver to sign up with this number, then invite again.
code.DRIVER_ALREADY_LINKED: This account already has an invitation or is already your driver.
code.DRIVER_LINK_STATE_CONFLICT: This driver link just changed. Please reload.
code.DRIVER_BUSY: This driver already has another trip at this time. Choose another driver.
code.DRIVER_ASSIGN_SERVICE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Only trips with a driver can have a driver assigned.
code.DRIVER_IS_TRIP_CUSTOMER: This driver is the customer of this trip. Choose another driver.
code.DRIVER_NOT_ASSIGNABLE: This driver is not available yet (invitation pending or suspended).
code.DRIVER_ASSIGNMENT_STATE_CONFLICT: This trip is no longer waiting for your answer.
code.DRIVER_ASSIGNMENT_EXPIRED: The time to confirm this trip has passed — it has gone back to the employer to assign another driver.
code.DRIVER_ASSIGNMENT_LOCKED: The car has been handed over or the booking has ended — the driver can no longer be changed.
code.DRIVER_HAS_ACTIVE_TRIP: This driver is on a trip. End the link after the vehicle is returned.
code.VEHICLE_SERVICE_IN_USE: This service can not be removed while the vehicle still has unfinished trips using it. Complete or cancel those trips first.
code.DRIVER_HAS_ACCEPTED_TRIPS: You still have accepted trips that have not started. Ask the employer to reassign them before you stop driving for them.
code.EXTERNAL_DRIVER_NOT_SUPPORTED: XePrime no longer accepts drivers outside the platform. Invite the driver to link their account, then assign them.
code.DRIVER_DROP_NOTE_REQUIRED: Please describe the problem (at least 10 characters) so the employer can rearrange the trip.
code.DRIVER_WAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The wage is outside the allowed range. See the valid range under the field.
code.DRIVER_WAGE_LOCKED: This trip's wage can no longer be edited (72 hours after the trip ended).
code.DRIVER_WAGE_NOT_APPLICABLE: The driver never accepted this trip, so there is no wage for this assignment.
code.DRIVER_WAGE_REQUIRED: Your shop has no default driver wage yet. Enter a wage for this trip.
code.WITH_DRIVER_PRICE_OUT_OF_RANGE: The with-driver daily price is outside the reasonable range. Check for a missing or extra zero.
code.DRIVER_SURCHARGE_RETIRED: Driver surcharges have been removed — the with-driver price is all-inclusive.
code.SURCHARGE_CATEGORY_RETIRED: This surcharge type has been removed — the with-driver price is all-inclusive.
code.SURCHARGE_NOT_ALLOWED_WITH_DRIVER: With-driver trips don't take overtime or excess-mileage surcharges — customers pay one all-inclusive price.
